name: Explorer Plugin
description: Combined split-pane explorer plugin. Horizontal flex layout: FileExplorerPlugin (left, 260px default, resizable 120-600px via drag handle) + MonacoEditorPlugin (right, flex:1, hidden when no tabs). Drag handle with hover accent color and cursor:col-resize. Bridges file explorer clicks to editor openFile(). Lazily creates CommandPalette on first Ctrl+P (openFileSearch). Delegates markdown opener configuration to FileExplorerPlugin (setMarkdownOpeners). Exposes getEditorState/restoreEditorState for workspace persistence. Editor column visibility toggles based on tab count. Auto-retries file explorer refresh after 1s for DOM readiness.
